reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Traefik Proxy v2.11.2 is end-of-life since 2026-09-07; the upgrade target v3.0.0 is not", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: Traefik Proxy v2.11.2 and earlier v2 versions are end-of-life; new security vulnerabilities are fixed in v3 only.

proposed.statement: Traefik Proxy v2 versions, with v2.11.2 as the last minor, reached end-of-life on 2026-09-07 and are no longer receiving security fixes; migration to v3 is required for continued security support.
